sources.title: Dorog város megalapozó vizsgálat
sources.role: Primary planning text confirms the residential estate morphology; archived actual streets/addresses determine the inferred estate extent.
facts: Printed pages 100-101 identify major estate green areas and distinguish their broader green/building fabric from individual buildings.
Printed pages 116-117 describe the central belt of named residential estates between southeastern and northwestern garden-city areas, and the Kenyérmezei stream as a structural feature.
The named estates are real address localities; none of the inferred envelopes is claimed to be an official cadastral perimeter.

fallbackPolicy: No circle, point-only bounding box, Voronoi or point hull. Estimate from named road/address evidence or a published map; keep low-confidence markers.
constructionSource: The collected geometries were constructed from archived OSM roads, full landuse compounds, buildings and address groups. Online planning text supplies context. No unavailable PDF/map binary is claimed as a traced input.
